verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships an installable engine (npm) and a REST API/Editor API that could in principle support scripted builds, but there is no documented CLI/headless "build & export" pipeline that replaces the browser Editor for full projects — the core workflow is Editor-cloud-based (docs-24, docs-25). Community hands-on reports explicitly contradict headless/local CI use: "there's no easy local dev environment... too risky" and assets must be uploaded via the Editor (comm-8, comm-9), which concretely undercuts the story. Missing for 10: an official documented CLI/build tool that performs full project export/build without opening the Editor, and independent confirmation it works in CI.
